dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. Grand Hotel Almaty. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Hello. I'd like to make a booking, please. For two nights — the 14th and 15th of June.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Of course. How many guests will be staying?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Just one — it's for me. I'd prefer a single room.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Let me check availability... We have a standard single room available at 18,000 tenge per night.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: It includes continental breakfast, yes. Check-in is from 2 p.m. and check-out is by 12 noon.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: That works perfectly. Is there Wi-Fi in the rooms?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Yes, complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. May I take your name and contact number?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Kamila Seitkali. My phone number is 8-705-321-4567.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: And how would you like to pay — by card on arrival, or would you like to secure the booking with a deposit?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I'll pay by card when I check in. Is a confirmation email possible?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Could I have your email address?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: It's kamila.seitkali at gmail.com. And one more thing — is there a cancellation policy?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Yes — free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in. After that, one night's charge applies.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: You're welcome, Ms Seitkali. We look forward to welcoming you on the 14th. Have a lovely day!
